subject: Kickoff: MobileBERT on-device NLU
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kicking off the MobileBERT productization (Mar 9 – Jul 20). The asset: our open-source thin BERT_LARGE with bottleneck structures and a carefully balanced split between self-attention and feed-forward capacity. The released artifacts give us a big head start — the uncased_L-24_H-128_B-512_A-4_F-4_OPT checkpoint plus float32 and quantized int8 SavedModels for SQuAD at sequence length 384, ready for tf.lite conversion.

Product story: the on-device assistant needs question-answering that runs on mid-tier phones without a server round trip. This is the launch-review candidate for the Q3 device release.

Milestones: April — SQuAD V1.1 fine-tune reproduced in-house; May — int8 path validated on our device farm; early July — final quality sweep; Jul 20 — launch-review packet.

Send staffing and the compute reservation plan when ready — the July sweep is the long pole.

Thanks,
Priya
